code.why: The descriptor's credentialDoor: the World's runtime calls it at every boot to issue the token the World's application holds as GITHUB_TOKEN (and GH_TOKEN, GITHUB_PAT, GITHUB_ACCESS_TOKEN). The life and the published examples walk the pack's fetch with the people's own tokens and boot no application; the client cases (packages/twin-standard/src/clients/github.ts) are the application that holds it.
An unrecognized path beneath /login/device is a malformed peer request, outside the device flow’s code, activation and consent paths.
An unrecognized path beneath /login/oauth is a malformed peer request, outside the authorization and access-token paths.
An unrecognized path on the Actions issuer host is a malformed peer request, outside discovery, JWKS and the runner’s idtoken request.
The listening HTTP host wraps the pack’s fetch; the customer life and published examples call fetch inside an in-memory World and start no listening host process.
